title: TCL 55C725 (reports as "Smart TV Pro", device BeyondTV4, product G03_4K_GB, Realtek rtd288o / R51MT05), 2 GB RAM
header:
TCL 55C725 (reports as "Smart TV Pro", device BeyondTV4, product G03_4K_GB, Realtek rtd288o / R51MT05), 2 GB RAM
Android TV 11 (SDK 30) with the Google TV launcher, build RP1A.200622.001, software V8-R51MT05-LF1V620. Italy.
Same software family as examples/tcl-43c645 (LF1V652) and the BeyondTV4 of examples/tcl-65c725, which shipped
the older com.google.android.tvlauncher; this unit runs launcherx.
Applied and verified on a real unit on 2026-10-20/21 (Ethernet, Wi-Fi off), with launcher/ as Home and a reboot.
Notes, remote keycodes and quirks: README.md in this folder.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-55c725/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-55c725/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx; launcher/build-and-install.sh disables it, it is not listed.
Never disable (from examples/tcl-43c645, same platform): com.tcl.providers.config com.tcl.initsetup
com.tcl.system.server com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service com.tcl.autopair com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.tv com.tcl.settings
com.tcl.inputmethod.international. Also kept here: com.tcl.suspension (Quick panel / Input), com.tcl.micmanager,
com.google.android.tv.assistant (assistant LED), com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService (device authentication, purpose
unclear, left alone).
